student-mean-interval.label: Student mean-interval margin
student-mean-interval.description: Divide the sample standard deviation by the square root of the reading count. Use the Student multiplier with one fewer degree of freedom, then place the resulting margin on both sides of the observed mean.

randomization-distribution.label: Eighth constructed learner score
randomization-distribution.description: Eighth constructed learner score. Receiving lessons retain their own input-domain checks.

randomization-distribution.label: Exact inclusive absolute-tail fraction
randomization-distribution.description: Keep eight learner scores fixed and enumerate all 70 ways to assign four learners to A and four to B. Count every allocation whose absolute mean difference is at least the observed difference, then divide that count by 70.

one-way-anova.description: Within-group deviation. Receiving lessons retain their own input-domain checks.

one-way-anova.label: Between/within mean-square ratio
one-way-anova.description: Separate the nine packing times into variation between three group means and variation within each group. Divide the two sums of squares by their degrees of freedom, then compare the mean squares with an F ratio.
